$comment: Detail budgets per graphics tier and model class. triangles is a ceiling (a model that is already lighter keeps what it has). error is the meshopt simplifier's tolerance as a fraction of the model's size: 0.02 (the old setting) let a 1 m shelf move 2 cm, which is what flattened the skateboard and the window blinds; 0.0005 is half a millimetre. colorPx is the base colour map, otherPx the normal / roughness / occlusion maps. Every texture is KTX2 UASTC (the high-quality Basis mode); the old files used ETC1S, which smears printed text and bands colour.
